scope.included: All 62 existing American land nodes plus 18 proposed land territories, including Greenland, Iceland, Faroe, Shetland and Azores. All current naval claims and prior proposed naval facilities were compared against freshly viewed source crops; all region coasts scanned for omitted symbols.
scope.excluded: European/African mainland and African Atlantic islands belong to Europe/Africa; Attu/Kiska and open Pacific islands belong to Asia/Pacific. Inland airfields are not naval facilities.
scope.method: Glyph type, white/blue/green background, land boundary, sea boundary and distinct physical icon were checked independently of live IDs. No dockyard or submarine-base glyph occurs in this assigned region.
scope.reviewed_sea_ids_semantics: Union of printed coast accesses and legacy facility claim sea IDs checked/rejected. Exact legal facility access is only expected_facilities[].sea_accesses.
